# TRU Sovereign Search Engine v2.0

**Air-gapped • Zero external dependencies • IndexedDB persistent**

Local **knowledge index** for the TRU offline network. It indexes what you load into it. It does not replace the domain lanes.

## What this is

- A single-file BM25 search UI over a **local** document set
- Structured seed: ~48 core KJV verses + TRU architecture cards
- Optional **packs** under `packs/` (network map, signal, water, storm bridges)
- Persistent notes and a lightweight relationship graph (IndexedDB)
- Import / export so the working set can move by hand between devices

## What this is not

| Need | Use instead |
|------|-------------|
| Full KJV + lexicon / cross-refs | [Canonbound](https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-canonbound) |
| FM 21-76 / FM 21-11 survival & first aid | [Lifeline](https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-lifeline) |
| Full distress / Morse / panel engine | [Signal](https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-signal) |
| EPA dose UI as its own card | [Water](https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-water) |
| Routing “which ship holds this ask?” | [Door](https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-door) |
| Catalog of all lanes | [Shelf](https://github.com/splashdown1/tru-shelf) |

Packs may **point at** those lanes or carry short sourced cards. They are not the full engines.

## Role in the fleet

| Layer | Job |
|-------|-----|
| **Shelf** | Catalog of lanes |
| **Door** | Routes the ask to the right ship |
| **Search** | Indexes what *you* hold locally |
| **Lanes** | Domain cards (Canonbound, Lifeline, …) |
| **Rules** | One file. A gap stays a gap. No call out. |

Live: https://splashdown1.github.io/tru-search-engine/

## How to use

1. Open `index.html` or the Pages URL.
2. Search the embedded seed; filter by book/tag; add notes; follow related edges.
3. **IMPORT** a pack from `packs/` (paste JSON) to expand the local index.
4. **EXPORT** to move docs + edges + notes offline.

## Packs

| Pack | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `tru-network-pack.json` | Rules + Shelf/Door/Search map |
| `tru-signal-pack.json` | Sourced distress/panel cards (full engine remains Signal) |
| `tru-water-pack.json` | EPA-aligned disinfection notes (full engine remains Water) |
| `tru-storm-pack.json` | Bridges to Lifeline and storm lanes — not medical advice |
| `tru-seed-full.json` | Larger structured seed for import |

## GitHub Pages

**Live source today:** branch **`gh-pages`**, root (`/`).  
URL: https://splashdown1.github.io/tru-search-engine/

`.nojekyll` is on the repo. A workflow at `.github/workflows/pages.yml` can deploy from `main` if you switch Pages → **GitHub Actions** and re-run the workflow; until then, keep **`gh-pages`** in sync when content changes.

## Design constraints

- Zero network calls after the file is saved
- Pure vanilla JS, single-file HTML
- A gap stays a gap — no invention, no remote fallback

---

**TRU** — Clarity toward salvation. Sovereign. Offline. Free.

name: Daily Integrity Checkpoint

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  checkpoint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout gh-pages (live tree)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages

      - name: Rebuild REF.json from artifacts
        run: |
          python3 << 'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, datetime
          def sha(path):
            with open(path, 'rb') as f:
              return hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()
          packs = {}
          if os.path.isdir('packs'):
            for name in sorted(os.listdir('packs')):
              if name.endswith('.json'):
                packs[name] = sha(os.path.join('packs', name))
          ref = {
            "v": "2.0.0",
            "as_of": datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),
            "role": "integrity marker only — does not feed the index",
            "index_sha256": sha('index.html') if os.path.exists('index.html') else None,
            "seed_sha256": sha('tru-seed-full.json') if os.path.exists('tru-seed-full.json') else None,
            "packs_sha256": packs,
            "pages": "https://splashdown1.github.io/tru-search-engine/",
            "note": "Compare locally when radio is on. Drift is a fact, not an auto-update. A gap stays a gap."
          }
          open('REF.json', 'w').write(json.dumps(ref, indent=2) + '\n')
          print(json.dumps(ref, indent=2))
          PY

      - name: Commit if REF changed
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add REF.json
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No REF change"
          else
            git commit -m "Daily integrity checkpoint $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
            git push origin HEAD:gh-pages
          fi

name: Patch Search boot fallback on: workflow_dispatch: push: paths: - '.github/workflows/patch-search-boot-fallback.yml' permissions: contents: write jobs: patch: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: ref: gh-pages - name: Apply memory-only boot fallback run: | python3 << 'PY' from pathlib import Path p = Path('index.html') html = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') old = '''catch(err){console.error(err);setSt("ERROR","bad");sb.textContent="Index failure: "+(err.message||err);document.getElementById("rs").innerHTML=`
Local storage error.
`}\n}''' new = '''catch(err){console.error(err);setSt("MEM","warn");\ntry{docs=merge([]);edges=[...SEDGES];idx=build(docs);ready=true;qi.disabled=false;fillFilters();\nsb.textContent="Memory only • storage blocked • "+docs.length+" seed nodes • search works";\nqi.focus();render([]);}catch(e2){sb.textContent="Index failure: "+(err.message||err);\ndocument.getElementById("rs").innerHTML=`
Local storage error. Try a normal (non-private) window.
`}\n}\n}''' if old not in html: if 'Memory only' in html: print('Already patched') else: raise SystemExit('catch block not found') else: html = html.replace(old, new, 1) html = html.replace('const VER="2.0.0"', 'const VER="2.0.2"', 1) html = html.replace('AIR-GAPPED • LOCAL ONLY • v2.0', 'AIR-GAPPED • LOCAL ONLY • v2.0.2', 1) html = html.replace('TRU Sovereign Search Engine v2.0', 'TRU Sovereign Search Engine v2.0.2', 1) p.write_text(html, encoding='utf-8') print('Patched', len(html)) PY - name: Commit run: | git config user.name "github-actions[bot]" git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" git add index.html if git diff --staged --quiet; then echo No change; else git commit -m "v2.0.2 — enable search when IndexedDB blocked (memory seed)" git push origin HEAD:gh-pages fi

name: Sync index from gh-pages

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/sync-index-from-gh-pages.yml'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          path: main-tree

      - name: Checkout gh-pages
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          path: live-tree

      - name: Copy full engine onto main
        run: |
          cp live-tree/index.html main-tree/index.html
          # Prefer single-file; drop external engine.js if present
          rm -f main-tree/engine.js
          cd main-tree
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add index.html
          git add -u engine.js || true
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "Already in sync"
          else
            git commit -m "Sync full single-file index.html from gh-pages"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
